question: Where can I find a gallery bounded by 130 kilometers distance toward the northwest of Eastern Museum of MotorSports Racing, York Springs, PA?
sql: WITH museum_location AS ( SELECT geometry AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Eastern Museum of MotorSports Racing%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%York Springs%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.id, p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, museum_location AS m WHERE p.tourism ILIKE '%gallery%' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, m.geom::geography, 130000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(m.geom, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5;
